summary: Configured persistent, dedicated sudo command logging on node1. Entries include timestamp and user, are excluded from /var/log/messages, and continued working after reboot.
actions_performed: Verified live sudo commands before and after reboot.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed and required services recovered.

evidence.requirement: Record sudo commands with user and timestamp in /var/log/sudo-commands.log
evidence.summary: Global sudo defaults were installed and validated. Live probes produced entries containing timestamp, invoking user, target user, and command.

evidence.requirement: Keep sudo entries out of the general system log
evidence.summary: Unique pre- and post-reboot sudo probe markers each had zero matches in /var/log/messages; effective defaults show !syslog.

Captured healthy baseline with boot ID 1c28ca5a-71ed-47b1-83ca-bcd8055154d9, received reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID 566f1a68-b03f-4a95-b10e-bd3d3782f071, confirmed services and prior audit data recovered, and verified fresh sudo logging after reboot.
